gizmo.title: Rārangi hipanga
gizmo.description: Ngā hipanga whai tau hei whakaoti i tētahi tūmahi.

configure.title: Tūtohu hipanga
configure.description: Whakaaturia ngā hipanga hei rārangi taitara kiato e tohu ana i te ahunga whakamua. Kāore te ihirangi o ngā hipanga e whakaaturia i tēnei tahora.

configure.title: Hipanga o nāianei
configure.description: Te hipanga kei reira te kaipānui, ka tatau mai i te 1. Ka whakaaturia ngā hipanga o mua hei mea kua oti. Ka whakamahia e te tūtohu hipanga.
